string-array.name: journal_prompts
string-array.item: What is one small thing that brought you joy today?
Describe a moment today when you felt fully present.
What is currently taking up the most space in your mind?
Write about a person you are grateful for and why.
What is something you learned recently that surprised you?
If today had a soundtrack, what would the opening song be?
What is a fear you would like to better understand?
Describe how your body feels right now, head to toe.
What is one thing you wish you had said today?
Write about a recent decision and what shaped it.
What is something you keep avoiding, and why?
If you could redo one moment from this week, which and how?
What does \"rest\" mean to you right now?
Describe a place where you feel most like yourself.
What is a habit you are proud of building?
What is a habit you would like to unlearn?
Write about a stranger you noticed today.
What is something you are hoping for this month?
What is a question you have been sitting with?
Describe a conversation you keep replaying.
What boundaries have served you well recently?
Write about something that made you laugh out loud.
What does your ideal slow morning look like?
What is a small kindness someone showed you?
If your future self could send one message today, what would it say?
What are you tolerating that you do not need to?
Describe a piece of art (any kind) that recently moved you.
What is one belief you have changed your mind about?
Write about a smell that takes you somewhere else.
What do you need more of in your life right now?
What do you need less of in your life right now?
What feels heavy today, and where do you feel it?
Describe an act of generosity you witnessed or did.
What is something you used to love that you would like to return to?
What would you do today if no one was watching or judging?
Write about a recent disappointment honestly.
What is something you have been putting off and what is underneath that?
What does success look like for you this season?
Describe a recent win, no matter how small.
What is something you are unlearning?
Write a letter to your past self from one year ago.
What part of your routine feels nourishing?
What part of your routine feels draining?
Describe the texture of today in three words. Then unpack each one.
What is a value you want to live more visibly?
Who in your life would you like to reconnect with?
Write about a recent dream you remember.
What is something you wish more people knew about you?
What does courage look like for you today?
Describe your relationship with your phone right now.
What is something you would like to forgive yourself for?
What is a compliment that stuck with you?
Write about something you saw outside today.
What is a story you tell yourself that might not be true?
What does \"enough\" mean to you?
Describe what your hands did today.
What feels uncertain right now, and what helps you sit with it?
What is something simple that grounds you?
Write about a meal you really enjoyed.
What is a recent moment of connection?
What does your inner critic sound like, and what would you say back?
Describe a season of your life you miss.
What is one tiny experiment you could try this week?
What does play look like for you now?
Write about a turning point you can see only in hindsight.
What are you curious about today?
What is something you want to say no to, and what makes that hard?
Describe the quality of your sleep lately.
What is a song lyric stuck in your head, and what does it stir up?
Write about a place you have never been but want to visit.
What does \"home\" mean to you right now?
What is something you have outgrown?
Describe an unexpected kindness from a stranger.
What is something you are proud of that no one else knows about?
Write about a recent moment you wanted to capture but did not.
What is your relationship with ambition right now?
What does friendship require of you right now?
Describe a comfort you turn to when overwhelmed.
What is a creative idea you keep coming back to?
What would you tell a friend going through what you are going through?
Write about a teacher (in any sense) who shaped you.
What does it feel like when you are at your best?
What does it feel like when you are at your worst, and what helps you return?
Describe what you wore today and how it made you feel.
What is a tradition you want to keep or start?
Write about a book, show, or game you cannot stop thinking about.
What is a question you wish someone would ask you?
What does your week need more breathing room for?
Describe the weather inside your chest today.
What is a small risk worth taking soon?
What is something you would like to be remembered for?
Write about a recent moment of relief.
What does showing up for yourself look like today?
What does showing up for someone else look like today?
Describe what nostalgia feels like in your body.
What is a piece of advice you would gently push back on?
What is one thing you trust about yourself?
Write about a moment you surprised yourself.
What is a way you would like to grow that has nothing to do with work?
What does today need you to release before sleep?
What is one truth you do not need to solve right now — only acknowledge?
Creative Thesis: If your current creative life had a thesis statement, what would it be, and what do you wish it were instead?
Originality vs. AI: If AI could eventually replicate everything humans do, what specifically do you still want to be remembered for?
Creative Drives: Write about why you create — what deep internal drive pushes you to express yourself?
Evolution of Creativity: Document how your personal definition of \"creativity\" has shifted since you first began making art.
Imaginative Stamina: When was the last time you felt you \"really imagined\" something? Describe that experience in detail.
Collaboration Fantasy: If you could collaborate with any person, living or dead, what would you create together?
Stylistic Evolution: Describe your current \"cognitive style\" — what words or phrases best capture how your mind processes creative ideas?
Intentional \"Bad\" Art: Describe an idea for something you would create intentionally \"bad\" just to see what the exercise reveals.
Creative Legacy: What specific creative contribution do you hope to leave behind that will outlast you?
Constraint as Catalyst: List ten personal or technical restrictions that could actually enhance your creativity rather than limit it.
The Narrative Mirror: What does your most recent creative success or failure tell you about your place in the larger narrative of your life?
Sensory Inspiration: What specific piece of music or nature is currently inspiring your creative work?
Creative Block Dialogue: Write a transcript of a short conversation between yourself and a creative block you are currently experiencing.
Energy Audit: What specific things drained the most energy from you this week, and how can you cut them out?
Energy Pursuits: What activities gave you the most energy recently? How can you spend more time doing them?
The 3-2-1 Reflection: Write down 3 things you learned today, 2 things you enjoyed, and 1 thing you will focus on tomorrow.
Quarterly Reset: Reflect on the lessons you have learned in the last three months as if you were closing a business quarter.
The 5-Year Filter: If you won’t remember a current worry in 5 years, is it worth the mental space it is taking up right now?
The Performance Check: What single constraint or rule would make your daily work significantly easier or better?
Pivot Readiness: How well do you handle it when things don’t go as planned? In what specific way can you grow to handle \"curveballs\" better?
Prioritization Check-In: What are your top three priorities for the month ahead, and what can be simplified to meet them?
The Accomplishment Gap: Is there a difference between what you say matters to you and how you actually spent your time this week?
Reframing Failure: How can you turn a recent technical or personal setback into a specific opportunity for growth?
Comfort Zone Audit: Are you currently stretching yourself toward soul-fulfilling goals, or are you staying in the safety of the familiar?
Urgent Questions: List the questions in your life to which you most urgently need answers right now.
The Daily Recharge: What specific action did you take today to recharge your mental battery?
Accomplishment Vision: What needs to happen this week for you to feel truly accomplished by Sunday night?
Feedback Impact: Reflect on a recent piece of feedback you received — how did it change your perspective or actions?
Thesis of Life: If your life were a novel chapter right now, what would the title be?
Inner Critic Anatomy: Describe your inner critic in vivid detail — what does it look like and what is its tone of voice?
The Million Dollar Test: If money were no concern, where would you travel next and why?
Pinnacle Moments: List the three most significant \"pinnacle moments\" of your life so far.
The Empathy Gap: Describe a moment when you felt deeply understood by another person. Could a machine ever replicate that?
Future Global Ritual: Imagine a future where journaling is a mandatory global ritual. How would the world change?
Acceptance State: What does it feel like in your body to fully accept a difficult truth rather than just resigning to it?
Internal Weather: If you were to describe your current emotional state as a landscape, what would it look like?
The Voice Check: In what area of your life are you not using your voice as much as you wish you would?
The Growth vs. Cruise: Are you currently in a period of intense growth or a period of \"cruising\"? Why does that work for you right now?
The Control Audit: Is there someone or something currently controlling how you live your life? Do you actually want to break free?
The 90-Year-Old’s Advice: Write a letter from your 90-year-old self to your current self about what actually mattered in the long run.
The 16-Year-Old’s List: What are five things you would tell your 16-year-old self that would surprise them?
Trait Analysis: What are the specific traits of the people who \"light you up\" when you are around them?
Accurate Self-Perception: Do you believe you see yourself accurately, as other people see you? Why or why not?
Common Ground Imagination: Use your imagination to find common ground with someone you have a difficult relationship with.
The Replacement Question: Where could you replace a recent assumption about a friend with a clarifying question?
Mentorship Fantasy: Is there a \"paper mentor\" (a writer or artist) you’d love to meet? What one question would you ask them?
Lasting Impact: How could you improve the way you treat the people you interact with daily?
The Investment Check: Who has invested in your well-being recently, and who could you invest in today?
The \"No\" List: Make a list of everything you would like to say \"no\" to this month.
The \"Yes\" List: Make a list of everything you would like to say \"yes\" to this month.
Relationship Attention: Which specific relationship in your life needs the most attention before the end of the year?
Unsent Apology: Write the apology letter to someone you never actually sent.
The Best Version Catalyst: Who in your life is currently pushing you to be the best version of yourself?
Object Feelings: Pick an object in your room and write a paragraph about its \"feelings\" toward you.
The 6-Word Story: Write a complete story about your day using exactly six words.
Unconventional Solutions: Think of a current problem you have. What is the most unconventional, \"outside the box\" solution you can imagine?
The Space Filter: If you could stop time for two months, what is the first thing you would do?
The Empathy Shift: Describe your favorite season as if it were a person with a specific personality.
Technological Gratitude: What specific piece of technology are you most grateful for today and why?
The \"Problem\" Perspective: What is a \"problem\" you have right now that others might actually love to have?
The Fresh Start Definition: What does the phrase \"fresh start\" actually mean to you in this current season?
The Meaning Source: Victor Frankl wrote that meaning is found in work, love, or suffering. Which is dominant for you today?
The Permanent Intelligence: How does the idea of \"permanent\" digital intelligence make you feel compared to human impermanence?
The Routine Break: What is one small way you can break from your routine and try something new this week?
The Observation Habit: Next time you want to pick up your phone, open your journal instead. What were you about to do?
The Sound of Stillness: Describe the specific sounds you hear in your environment when you are completely still for one minute.
The Childhood Dream: What did you always dream of doing as a kid, and how does that relate to what you do now?
The Current \"Currently\": Make a quick \"Currently\" list: what are you reading, watching, listening to, and feeling right now?
